Sound Atlas material assets

All nine JPEG texture maps in this directory are unmodified 1K files downloaded from Poly Haven.
Poly Haven licenses its texture assets under CC0 1.0 and permits use, modification and redistribution.
Asset license: https://polyhaven.com/license
CC0 deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Floor - Concrete Floor Worn 001
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_floor_worn_001
Authors: Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing).

Desk wood - White Oak Veneer
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/white_oak_veneer
Author: Jenelle van Heerden.

Wall - White Plaster 02
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_02
Author: Rob Tuytel.

Material files and integrity hashes are recorded in materials.json.
These materials form a visualization proposal. They are not a reconstruction of verified on-site finishes.
Color maps use sRGB. Normal and roughness maps are linear data maps. Normal maps use the OpenGL convention.
